name: PEDIGREE
description: An IETF Internet-Draft extending SPIFFE with per-agent delegation and scope reduction.
descriptionZh: 一份扩展 SPIFFE 的 IETF 草案，增加逐 Agent 委托与权限范围递减。
keyFact: PEDIGREE (Per-Agent Delegation Identity with Governance-Enforced Execution) is an individual IETF Internet-Draft published 25 April 2026 under the WIMSE working group; it extends the SPIFFE workload identity model with hop-by-hop encrypted delegation, monotonic scope reduction and two-layer authority enforcement.
keyFactZh: PEDIGREE（Per-Agent Delegation Identity with Governance-Enforced Execution）是 2026 年 4 月 25 日发布的个人 IETF 草案，归属 WIMSE 工作组；它在 SPIFFE 工作负载身份模型之上增加了逐跳加密委托、单调递减的权限范围与双层权限强制。
caveat: A single-author, early-stage Internet-Draft with no formal IETF standing — it is not a standard or a finished project, and maturity claims should be discounted accordingly.
caveatZh: 单人作者的早期 Internet-Draft，不具备 IETF 正式地位——既非标准也非成熟项目，评估时应对其成熟度打折。
